unlocks.title: Locked Out
unlocks.when: shell output: a `tofu` command that prints `Error acquiring the state lock`

unlocks.title: Fat Fingers
unlocks.joke: A typo in a resource name.
unlocks.when: shell output: `tofu validate` or `plan` fails printing `Reference to undeclared`

unlocks.title: Auto Approve Bravado
unlocks.when: shell: `tofu apply -auto-approve` (exit 0); "on the first try" is not checked

unlocks.title: Destroy First
unlocks.when: shell: `tofu destroy` before the student has ever run a successful `tofu apply`

unlocks.title: State in Git
unlocks.when: shell: a `git add` naming `terraform.tfstate` (exit 0); the push payload's file list is not read
